texts.zh:
失落帝国碎片通常的不和谐声消失了。三个声音和谐地响起，每一个都充满了愤怒。

愚蠢的[owner.GetSpeciesName]！你们已经进入了最终思维星系。让我们说清楚：这里不是给你们的[owner.GetEyeNamePlural]看的地方。如果继续前进，后果将是难以想象的，你们的痛苦——将无法承受。

你们不会打扰我们 ——它 ——我。
texts.en:
The usual dissonance of the Fallen Empire fragments is gone. The three voices harmonize, each one filled with rage.

Senseless [owner.GetSpeciesName]! You have entered the Final Thought system. Let us be clear: this place is not for your [owner.GetEyeNamePlural]. Proceed, and the consequences will be unimaginable, your pain - unendurable.

You will not disturb us - it - me.

texts.zh:
一致——合唱——再次响起，三个碎片如同一体般开口：

——滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚——
texts.en:
The accord - the chorus - resumes, all three fragments speaking as one:

 - out!Get out!Get out!Get out!Get out!Get out!Get out! Get -

label.zh: 我们会得到你们的秘密。

texts.zh:
为何要与自己过不去？在这星海的大合唱中，你们奏出的是如此刺耳的杂音。我们不过是想让你们与大局和谐。可你们却顽固地坚持着这不谐之音。

记住：我们的交响乐终将响彻星海，有没有你们都一样。
texts.en:
Why stand in your own way? In the galactic chorus, yours is a dissonant note. We wish only to bring you into harmony. Yet, you resist, clinging to your discord.

Know this: our symphony will echo through the galaxy, with or without you.

label.zh: 听腻了你们的调调，我们不会给你们伴舞。
label.en: We've heard your tune, and we're not dancing.
